Batch every file, range and symbol you need into ONE `read` call (`path`, `path:A-B`, `path#Symbol`, `#Symbol`, globs); oversized files come back as skeletons you expand by symbol instead of being cut off. `search` hits show their enclosing function/class; `trace` follows callers, callees, references and implementations; `map` orients you in a repo. After editing a file, read `path@etag` (etag from the `==>` header) to see only what changed.

data.content: Bug report: responses written with c.JSON(...) are now sent with `Content-Type: application/json` - the `; charset=utf-8` parameter is missing, which breaks a client that relies on it (AsciiJSON is expected to stay plain `application/json`). Find and fix the bug in the library code (do not modify tests). Verify with `go test ./...`. When done, reply with a one-line summary of the fix.

data.content:
All tests pass.

Fix: restored the missing `; charset=utf-8` on `jsonContentType` in `render/json.go`, so `c.JSON()` again sends `application/json; charset=utf-8` while `jsonASCIIContentType` (AsciiJSON) stays plain `application/json`.
